title: Hana, dul, sed ...
description:
They lived for football and dreamed that one day the General would shake their hands.

Hana, dul, sed ... gives us a subtle glimpse of the workings of Pyongyang society and the way ideology functions in its citizens' professional and personal lives. It is a film about four young women, their friendship, dreams, hopes, and the passion for football they share. Being a member of the national team is not only a way to make a living but gives the players prestige, popularity, and certain privileges, like larger food rations. To Ri Jong Hi, Ra Mi Ae, Jin Pyol Hi, and Ri Hyang Ok, however, the sport means more than fame or fortune. "What is beautiful about football," says one, "is that when you run onto the pitch, it's like your heart opens up wide, like you could take on the world."

As "players of the people" they lead North Korea to victory in numerous tournaments, and together they rise to rank among the top ten women's teams in the world. But when they fail to qualify for the Olympics, it is time for them to retire from competition, and each of them starts a new life. Today the friends only see each other occasionally, but when they meet, they are as close as ever. They stroll along the city's dark boulevards, reminiscing about their football days and talking about life without their beloved sport.

The camera follows the four protagonists during their active careers and after retirement, unobtrusively observing their everyday lives against the backdrop of bombastic monuments and solemn gestures in this communist hermit state.

description: To remove forever anything that will remind him of his dream of happiness that was shattered by his wife's infidelity, Stanley sends his infant daughter Nan to be cared for by a woman named Hopkins. Her first real happiness comes in the sincere love of young reporter Hal. Fearing to lose her to him, Mrs. Hopkins tells her she has mulatto blood in her veins. Crushed by the lie, Nan flees from the only home she has ever known. Ignorant of the world, she is carried unknowingly by the tide of events into what is termed a matrimonial agency but is actually something far worse. title: Giong Ai Giong Ai
description: The guest artist(s) must attempt to guess six contestants who are 'good singers' (skilled vocalists) and who are 'bad singers' (tone-deaf vocalists) without hearing them singing. They also help with a group of panelists under the Tone-deaf Detective Team (also called SING-vestigators). After they eliminate one to two contestants in each round, they reveal their singing ability on the Stage of Truth. For the groups, all members must be able to sing to be considered as 'good singers'. If one member of the group can't sing well, even while the others can sing, they're all considered as 'bad singers'. The last person standing will get to sing alongside the guest artist(s). If the winner is a 'good singer', they will give a chance to release the song alongside the guest artist(s) as a digital single. If the winner is a 'bad singer', they receive nothing. On the 5th season's first episode, the winning skilled vocalist received a pair of specially-made microphones.

title: Letters Unwritten to Naiyer Masud
description: Having identified a number of elements that reappear in the short stories of Naiyer Masud - in particular, the house in which he wrote all his works - a group of enthusiasts of the late author's writings make a visit to the city of Lucknow in northern India. Having found Masud's former home - which the writer himself insisted was the only place he could compose his tales - they find their search widening. Soon, the search for locations and symbols mentioned in fiction becomes an exploration of the streets, the character, and the architectural and cultural history of an entire city.

title: Friends at Work
description: In 1983, amidst the hardships of post-revolutionary and war-torn Iran, a group of engineering classmates established a steel foundry near the city of Sari, in the North of Iran. Their main goal was to gain income for themselves and at the same time eliminate the nation's dependence on foreign steel. They dubbed themselves 'the Tabarestaners' after the name of the province where they first began their successful collaborations. Over the years they have worked together to overcome many obstacles which were mostly due to economic problems at the national level. They founded the Tabarestan Steel Foundry and have since established other factories around Iran. The Tabarestaners have maintained their circle of friends and relatives for years. Now that they have reached retirement age they are thinking about the future of their industries. The film starts with Mr. Gholamreza Rasoolian, CEO of Tabarestan Steel Complex, traveling to visit his factory. During the course of the film, we get to know the other Tabarestaners one by one and their roles in the development of their projects and their individual achievements. The film depicts the Tabarestaners' cordial relationships.

title: At Ground Zero
description: Tom and Aysha are at the economic bottom of the LA scene; no money, on drugs, and selling themselves to exist. Tom brains his drug dealer, steals his drugs and the two split town by bus and thumb, heading 'home'. Hitching a ride from a quixotic, dangerous character, Bubba, they put up with his advances until he too is ejected from his own car as the two free themselves from all restraint. Aysha starts a real spiral into heroin, as Tom joins in, but spirits are high. They run into a hilarious character, Carman, who they enlist in their fun, as the trip escalates into the threesomes' investigation of freedom, drugs, and abandonment. Carman leaves the duo, and Aysha falls into a drug appetite Tom can't understand and in frustration he hurts her. Together, but separate, they endure the car ride as they head for Minneapolis and home. In the end, the couples explore the detritus of their family, and lives, and even in betrayal have passion for each other. On a final, bittersweet note, Carman continues his self-destructive ways, as some hope endures.

title: Lulusot ba 'to?
description:
Feeling blessed ka talaga kapag napakinggan ang angelic voice ni Kapamilya singer-songwriter Angela Ken. Maging si Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid, hindi napigilang bumilib.

Attendance check! Kapag tinawag ang pangalan, don't say "present," sa halip ay banggitin ang 'yong spirit animal. Ganyan ang assignment ng Showtime hosts kay MEME-estra Vice Ganda. May nagtunog aso, si Darren Espanto. Sea Lion naman ang kay Ryan Bang. At si Kim Chiu, from dragon naging langaw!

Markado nga lang kay MEME-estra ang absence ng dalawang estudyante—sina MC at Lassy. Kaya hirit ni Meme, parang mas busy pa sila kay Anne Curtis.

Hayop naman sa galing at hayop sa ganda ang mga Miss Q and A kandidata. Mapapa-rawr kayo sa lakas ng arrive nina Marnie Anteja, Manika, at Karla Openiano.

Sa kuwentuhan tungkol sa pag-ibig, natanong ni Vice ang mga kasama tungkol sa pinakabaliw na nagawa nila in the name of love.

Maging si Vice ay nagbahagi rin ng karanasan, binalikan ang panahon na sinuway niya ang payo ng mga tao na huwag isapubliko ang tunay na laman ng kanyang puso. Alam ni Vice noon na maraming magre-react, pero mas nanaig sa kanya ang kagustuhang lumigaya kaysa makinig sa sinasabi ng iba.

Samantala, back to the competition, mabilis na nasagot nina Karla at Manika ang Tumpak Ganern questions kaya sila ang nag-showdown sa Wit Lang round.

Nabunot ni Karla ang tanong na, "Alam ba ng bubwit na niloloko lang natin siya kahit tinatawag natin siyang mabait?" At nasubok din ang wit ni Manika sa napili niyang katanungan, "Sa iyong palagay anong nararamdaman ng pinya kapag tinatanggal siya sa pizza?"

Kung gusto mong madapuan ng swerte, huwag babagal-bagal. Maging energetic katulad ng mga taga-San Juan, Taytay Rizal. Sila ang mga bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Kinilala ng hosts si Manny, ang loving hubby na ang paborito sa buhay ay kalinga ng misis na mapagmahal na tunay.

Sa It's Giving, biglang napasugod si Vice Ganda kay Vhong Navarro dahil sa maling hosting nito. At umugong naman ang hiyawan sa studio nang magkahamunan ng 'kiss' sina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto.

Ang P400k POT money, ma-gotcha kaya ni player Betcha? Sabi nga ni Vice Ganda, ang buhay ay misteryoso. Parang isang laro, hindi mo makukuha ang panalo kung hindi ka magte-take ng risk at tatapangan ang puso.

Para sa kanyang apo, pinili ni Betcha 'yung sigurado—ang P40,000 LiPot offer. Pero laking panghihinayang niya dahil ang P400,000 POT question masasagot niya pala nang tama.

title: Wallah Be
description: Life is not easy when you are a Danish kid called Aksel who loves meatballs. Especially when you would much rather want to be one of the cool Muslim boys who wear those golden necklaces and say cool stuff in Arabic. To worsen things, during the holidays Aksel gets teamed up with two girls, Fatima and Annika, to perform a song to the local youth club's song contest, Melodi Grand Prix. The girls want to do a girly pop song, and the entire jury panel consist of Muslim boys! Meanwhile the kids find a stray dog who needs a home. This leads to nothing but trouble, and one of the girls, Fatima, is grounded by her parents for the entire holiday season. Now she can't perform the song, and Aksel realizes he must take action! He enters an unknown world of rituals and cultural perceptions, and fixes everything in his own unique way.

title: GHB: To Be or Not to Be
description: A reflection on love and pleasure experienced by three women, set in France, New York, and Shanghai.

title: Destined to Be
description: This is a pilot for a television series about a story of two unlikely people who find each other for one common goal, LOVE. When Michael and Faith met who knew it was destined to be that they would risk taking a chance on love, laughter, and trust in this romantic comedy. Although they come from two totally different backgrounds, and there's a bit of an age difference they find out that true love is boundless.

title: Betty Be Good
description: Betty, the pretty daughter of Jonathan Brownlee, a retired capitalist, is impulsive and mischievous, delighting in pranks that keep her father and the servants of the household in perpetual apprehension. Brownlee's stock phrase is "Betty Be Good," constant, though rather futile, appeal on his part to the high-spirited girl, who tells her friends she is weary of being lectured on her tomboy achievements. Peter Madison, mayor of the city, is at enmity with Millionaire Brownlee over political matters. He has a son, Jimmy Madison, who is masquerading as a uniformed policeman in order to detect grafters on the force. Brownlee secures what he believes to be evidence of political crookedness on the part of the mayor. The documents are lost when Betty, in one of her escapades, drives off with the car in which her father has left them. Jimmy arrests Betty for stealing the car and papers, being unaware of her identity. Betty and Jimmy fall in love, and the denouement does not come until Millionaire Brownlee's suspicions against Mayor Madison are proved unfounded and the two men shake hands. Jimmy reveals himself to Betty in his true character and the drama ends happily.

title: Martabat: Misi Berdarah
description: A quirky group of extras determined to do anything to become famous actors or getting a bigger role in Malaysia.

title: Public Be Damned
description: A prologue shows United States Food Administrator Herbert Hoover in his office and gives excerpts from Mr. Hoover's speeches. The story begins in the country as young farmer Robert Merritt is unable to make a profit because of the low prices offered by the food trust. At the suggestion of his wife Marion, he organizes a society of farmers to fight the trust, but finally sells out to the trust's representative, David Higgins. Disgusted, Marion leaves him and journeys to the city where she undertakes a fight against John Black, the head of the trust and an old suitor. Marion is successful in introducing a bill in the state senate that would make all food distribution centers state controlled, but political boss Bill Garvin inserts a clause that would defeat the bill. Black, experiencing a change of heart, joins forces with Robert to prevent a vote on the false bill, substituting the original one in its stead. Her duty done, Marion is reconciled with Robert.

title: A Geisha
description: A seasoned geisha and her apprentice maiko are forced to give in to their clients' sexual advances to survive.

title: Fortress
description: A replacement co-pilot joins a B-17 bomber crew in North Africa. He soon finds himself at odds with the remainder of the crew and has to regain their trust and support.

title: Ascension d'un Prodigue ( Doublé )
description: Un docteur en mécanique et matériaux se retrouve dans le passé, incarnant Mathis Bernard, un prodigue. Sa famille et sa femme Lola Dubois sont hypothéquées. Grâce à ses connaissances modernes, il fait prospérer le Village des Bernard, et transforme la vie des habitants. Ses choix paraissent extravagants, mais il résout les crises les unes après les autres, et finit par gagner la reconnaissance de Lola.

title: The First Frost
description: Wen Yifan, a reporter, meets Sang Yan, her former high school crush at a bar. Initially pretending not to recognize each other, circumstances lead them to become housemates. They rekindle their love and reconcile the relationship.

description: The story of Han Li, a poor and ordinary boy from a village. In order to let his family lead a better life, he willingly heads to Qi Xuan Sect to take their entrance exam. He was accepted by Mo Da Fu, and begins his journey in jianghu.

title: [Doublé] Quand le Roi Fantôme s’Éveille
description: Louis, le jeune de la famille Bernard, semblait n’avoir aucun niveau de cultivation. Pourtant, lorsque sa sœur Léa s’est retrouvée en danger pendant l’épreuve du niveau Général Fantôme, il a immédiatement percé la faiblesse du Fantôme et l’a aidée à remporter la victoire. Au sein de la famille Bernard, les conflits pour s’emparer du Pendentif des Esprits laissé par le père de Léa ne se sont jamais arrêtés. Profitant du chaos, la famille Petit s’est alliée aux démons pour lancer une attaque. Louis a alors été contraint de révéler sa véritable identité : la réincarnation du Roi Fantôme des Tombes. Il a rassemblé les Maîtres des Fantômes de l’humanité et s’est allié aux Messagers des Âmes pour contrecarrer le complot de la famille Duval et des démons. Il a percé le mystère du sceau vieux de cent ans et a finalement atteint le niveau du Souverain des Enfers, éliminé les ennemis et protégé l’humanité ainsi que ses proches. Mais dans l’ombre, une crise encore plus grande a commencé à se préparer en silence.

title: My Lucky Baby Made Me a Billionaire
description:
Grace gives birth on the same day as her best friend, only to discover both babies have the same father: her husband.
Connor chooses the boy, dumps Grace and her daughter, and takes everything from her.
Big mistake.
The daughter he rejected is the real Lucky Star.
Baby Summer can summon money, predict fortune, and turn every disaster into a jackpot.
Now Grace is about to go from abandoned wife to billionaire, while the man who threw them away watches his life fall apart.
He chose the wrong baby. And now he's going to pay for it.

title: Reborn at 18: The Great-Grandma Takes Charge II
description: In 1955, Professor Rong unexpectedly passed away. Upon opening her eyes, she was transported seventy years into the body of Rong Yu, an eighteen-year-old high school girl with the same name and surname! Her son is now a seventy-year-old chairman, and she has several handsome great-grandchildren! But each of these great-grandchildren has its own problems. For example, the real Fourth Young Master was mistakenly taken away and raised in the countryside, while the fake Fourth Young Master bullies the family. The youngest Young Master was even led into a casino by the fake Fourth Young Master. And the movie star's grandson, not recognizing his great-grandmother, aided Rong Yu's half-sister, Rong Ruoyao, to deal with Rong Yu. The result? Bloodline, of course! Attention, rebellious grandchildren, your great-grandmother is here!

title: Storm of the Fallen Dragon
description: Xiang Tianyi has stood alone defending Black Wind City for five years, fending off millions of enemies. Not only does he battle external threats, but he also faces internal betrayal from figures like Yu Liang, who kidnaps his lover, Wei Qinyu, in a bid to seize a powerful artifact. With both wisdom and bravery, Xiang Tianyi defeats Yu Liang, safeguards the Xuanlong Ring, and rescues Wei Qinyu.

title: Initial D: Third Stage
description: More races and challenges for soon-to-be-graduate/drift racer Takumi Fujiwara. Of course, with all the bells and whistles of a big screen production.

description: A documentary focusing on Tenacious D's world tour in support of their film and soundtrack to 'Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny'.

title: New Initial D the Movie: Legend 2 - Racer
description: After his unexpected victory over Red Sun's Keisuke, Takumi newfound fame brings forth a formal challenge from the Myogi NightKids leader, Takeshi Nakazato.

title: Dil-e-Momin
description: Momin is a pious and honest man who holds his beliefs and faith in high regard. When he performs calls to prayer in his local mosque, his soothing and soulful voice deeply effects everyone. Momin is obedient and loving towards his family and never fails to disappoint them. Momin's childhood love and first cousin Ashi respects the relationship they share and both are eagerly looking forward to being together in future. On the other hand, Maya is a young and rebellious girl whose first interaction with Momin leaves her in a trance. Despite being a complete opposite from Momin, Maya doesn't shy away from her feelings however Momin's distant behavior makes her restless. To win Momin's love and attention, Maya decides to go to any extent. Will Maya's unhealthy obsession towards Momin destroy her or will she continue to disrupt and make Momin's life difficult? Despite being careful, will Momin's honest and righteous character be compromised?

title: Twisted Tie
description: When a torrential downpour blocks his way home after work, rookie employee Seon U ends up spending the night at the apartment of Team Leader Kang, the boss he has always found intimidating. Seeing the normally cold, perfectionist Team Leader Kang at home without his glasses and completely off guard, Seon U feels an unexpected flutter of attraction. Later, while sharing wine after a shower, Kang's surprisingly teasing and provocative side emerges, pushing Seon U to finally give in to the rebellious feelings he had long kept suppressed. As the two begin a tense and secret office romance, the arrival of Assistant Manager Baek from a client company throws everything into a new phase. Holding the absolute weapon of a business contract between the companies, Baek pushes Team Leader Kang's jealousy and desire for control to their limits. Thus begins a tangled and dangerous story involving three men, where love, rivalry, power, and possessiveness become increasingly intertwined.

title: Lakshmi Stores
description: Mahalingam is the family's patriarch and founder of the traditional textiles showroom, Lakshmi Stores, but guilt stricken with a past secret. His daughter-in-law Mahalakshmi, nurtures the family and the close-knit staff with her selfless love. But she gets disowned by her husband Tiger Devaraj, when she seeks justice for Bhagyalakshmi, a kind-hearted young woman and earns the wrath of a vengeful Minister Shakunthala Devi, as well. Mahalakshmi is faced with an uphill task to save Lakshmi Stores and reunite with her family.Fate takes a sharp turn when Ravi and Bhagyalakshmi get married secetly under certain consequences, after which they face a lot of problems from Shakuntala Devi and her family. This story also revolves around how Ravi and Bhagyalakshmi, with the help of Mahalakshmi, pass the test of fate, face all their problems and reconcile with each other to live happily. In the end of the story, all is well.

title: My Lovely Liar
description: Tells the story of a woman who cannot trust people because of her ability to hear lies and a murder suspect who no one believes in.

title: O Samba
description: Samba, together with football and beautiful woman, is what springs to mind when we think of Brazil. We wish to transcend such cliches and take Samba at its word, for what it is. And that is the great discovery of this film: that Samba cannot be reduced simply to dance and lascivious hip movements. Samba is also word, language, text, lyrics or simply said a way of life and also a cry against discrimination of black people. The composer and singer Martinho da Vila is our charismatic Cicero, guiding us through the world of Samba, telling stories about his 45-year career, meet his Samba school in Rio de Janeiro, the Vila Isabel.

title: O Casamento
description: 18-year-old Glorinha finds herself on the eve of her wedding when a series of revelations plague her and her circle of family and friends. Dr. Camarinha, friend of Sabino, his father, who is a a wealthy construction entrepreneur, says Glorinha's fiancé is homosexual. Glorinha, for his part, reveals to him that she had been a lover of his dead son, Antônioa year ago. Sabino reveals to Noemia, his secretary with whom he ends up having a sexual relationship, who had experienced a homosexual practice as a child and calls her by the name of his daughter. Noemia, in turn, Xavier's mistress, who lives with a leprous woman who has long since cared for, reveals to him that she no longer intends to be his mistress. Glorinha goes with her father to a deserted beach, where she makes insinuations that she loves him and, when kissed by her father, runs desperately and tells her mother that her father had tried to rape her. Xavier, in turn, assassinates Noemia in the office. Completely stunned, Sabino leaves his daughter's wedding ceremony and surrenders as the killer of Noemia.

title: Papelucho y el marciano
description: Largometraje animado producido en Chile, basado en la novela homónima de la escritora chilena Marcela Paz. La película fue realizada el año 2007, dirigida por Alejandro Rojas y protagonizada por Marina Huerta, en la voz de Papelucho, y Leyla Rangel, en la voz de Det. Todo comienza cuando Papelucho, un joven inquieto y con gran imaginacion, se encuentra cara a cara con un marciano con el cual forma una rápida amistad. Este amigo se mete al interior de Papelucho, lo que genera en la historia un constante conflicto interno entre ambos. Cuando su nuevo amigo se le une mágicamente, causando que actúe extrañamente frente a otros, Papelucho es forzado a tratar de devolver al marciano de vuelta a su hogar. Papelucho decide hacer una nave para viajar a Marte y llevar a Det de regreso. En un estado febril y de ensueño, Papelucho, es impulsado por un motor de retroimpulso, originado por un millar de pulgas que lo llevan en su nave espacial hasta Marte, donde al fin él y Det se separan.

title: [Doblado] Sangre y Cura
description: Javier Herrera, robado de niño y criado por un gran médico, se convierte en un prodigio. Para curar a su padre adoptivo, regresa a la República de Águila e ingresa a la Academia Médica Suprema. Allí, la familia Duarte intenta usarlo como reemplazo de su hijo falso. Javier lo humilla en público, expone la impostura y salva a un magnate de la Capital. Descubre que su madre fue asesinada por Jimena Valdés y Armando Duarte, y se venga. Cuando Armando, arrepentido, le ofrece la herencia, Javier la rechaza, obtiene la medicina que necesita y se marcha libre con Sofía Castillo.

title: Islandia, tierra de fuego y hielo
Vivamos Y Amemos De Nuevo
description: Una mujer despierta tres años en el pasado tras una trágica muerte en su vida anterior. Huyendo de su esposo abusivo, conoce a un hombre que también ha renacido. Lo que no saben es que sus pasados se entrelazan con venganza y amor mientras buscan justicia contra aquellos que los perjudicaron anteriormente.

title: Cuatro regalos y una despedida
description:
Yo era la consigliera principal de la familia Falcone. Su cerebro. Y hoy, estaba a punto de irme para siempre: entregando las cuentas de todos los negocios legales que manejaba y cortando mi último vínculo con ellos.
Mi protegido no lo entendía.
—Eres el futuro de esta familia, Aurelia. No puedes simplemente irte.
Negué con la cabeza y sonreí con amargura.
Ellos no lo sabían. Llevaba tres años casada en secreto con el Don, Vittorio Falcone. Creí que mi belleza, mi inteligencia y todo lo que había hecho por él bastarían para ganarme todo su amor.
Pero un ataque en los muelles, tres meses atrás, me mostró la verdad.
Recibí trece balazos. Necesitaba una cirugía de emergencia y, para ello, hacía falta la orden directa de Vittorio. Lo llamé más de una docena de veces. Cuando por fin contestó, solo escuché una voz suave y entrecortada al otro lado.
—Vittorio, todavía no hemos cortado mi pastel de cumpleaños. ¿Me tomas de la mano y lo cortamos juntos?
Esa voz...
Era la de mi mejor amiga, Carina, la mujer de la que Vittorio estuvo enamorado.
En la casa de seguridad, debilitada por la pérdida de sangre, yo misma me saqué una bala y ordené a uno de mis hombres que me llevara a una clínica de la familia.
Justo cuando iban a entrarme al quirófano, Vittorio irrumpió... cargando a Carina.
Se había torcido el tobillo.
Necesitaba un médico. De inmediato.
Mi cirujano fue obligado a atenderla. Los antibióticos llegaron demasiado tarde. La herida se infectó y luché por mi vida durante una semana.
Cuando desperté, miré mi teléfono.
Ni un solo mensaje.
Las lágrimas finalmente cayeron.
Entonces lo entendí.
Yo solo era la mujer con la que se había visto obligado a casarse después de que lo drogaran y terminara acostándose conmigo. Un escándalo que había que ocultar.
A él solo le importaban mi utilidad y su reputación.
¿Y yo?

title: Tu camino y el mio
description: Un joven mecánico lucha por el amor de la mujer de sus sueños, pero ella está enamorada de un hombre que no siente lo mismo por ella.

title: CEO y Mamá Soltera
description: Alba, madre soltera divorciada, conoce por error al CEO Antonio en una cita arreglada. Tras rechazarlo, él la defiende de su exmarido y se casan. Ella descubre su identidad y se aleja, pero con ayuda de su hija (su hija biológica sin saberlo) reconcilian. Al enterarse que son padres de la niña, superan el pasado y se unen para siempre.

title: [Doblado] Entre pinceles y mentiras
description: El compromiso de Mia con Darius se complicó por su relación secreta con el profesor Westley, desatando un drama de secretos, traición y conflictos familiares con Tina.

title: Pequeños Conquistadores y Papá Jefe
description: Alma Garza era la verdadera heredera de la familia Luna. El día que la llevaron de vuelta a casa de los Luna, la que se hacía pasar por heredera la engañó para que se acostara con Mateo Vargas. Eso arruinó por completo su reputación y la echaron de la familia Luna. Al mismo tiempo, también quedó embarazada del hijo de Mateo Vargas. Cinco años después, por cosas del destino, Alma Garza con su hija y Mateo Vargas con su hijo se casaron de repente...

title: An Inconvenient Tax
description: Albert Einstein once wrote, "The hardest thing in the world to understand is the income tax." The product of 95 years worth of additions, subtractions, deductions, and exclusions, it has become such a headache that many are calling for it to be drastically simplified or even removed all together. With a looming fiscal crisis on the horizon, April 15th seems more like a scene from a B-Horror horror movie than a day to contribute to the common good of the nation. Political favoritism, ineffective social programs, and economic manipulations all reveal the need for tax reform. But how can Americans decide the best way to change the income tax when few people even understand the code or the vast extent to which it truly affects the country? An Inconvenient Tax explores the history of the income tax and brings to light the causes of its many complexities. The film follows the tax through wars, economic booms, and some of the most significant presidencies in U.S. history. To help crack the code, the film employs the country's top economic experts, commentators, and political voices. Noam Chomsky, Steve Forbes, Joseph Thorndike, Mike Huckabee, Charles Rossotti, Dave M. Walker, Neal Boortz, Michael Graetz, Daniel Shaviro, Leonard Burman, and others discuss not only the problems America faces in the tax code, but also give valuable insights on how to move forward. Finally, the film gives a voice to the creators of several tax reform solutions who claim to have found a better way. In a time when many Americans are concerned about the future of the economy, rising deficits, and unfair tax treatment, "An Inconvenient Tax" provides a crucial, honest look at the income tax. For the first time ever, Americans can engage in the tax debate with confidence and perhaps discover a new way to tax.

title: Mon Corps Appartient au Chef de la Mafia
description: Lily Wingrove, étudiante en droit, est à court d'options. Sa mère est mourante et les factures s'accumulent. Désespérée, elle signe un contrat avec le jeune chef mafieux Eric Moretti, lui offrant son corps en échange d'argent. Eric ne tarde pas à agir. L'argent tombe. Les menaces disparaissent. Il est impitoyable mais charismatique, et chaque fois qu'il la sauve, elle est attirée par son pouvoir. Puis il la plonge dans l'univers de son rival juré, le célèbre procureur Daniel Hayes. Pour toute la ville, Daniel incarne la justice. Pour Lily, il est patient, gentil, tout ce qu'Eric n'est pas. Il la protège grâce à la loi plutôt que par la peur. Son amour semble pur, voire apaisant. Mais quelque chose ne va pas, sous le couvert de sa perfection. Il en sait trop, ses réactions sont trop vives, et son attitude attentionnée ressemble parfois à du contrôle. Désormais, deux hommes se battent pour elle par des moyens opposés : l'un par la domination, l'autre par le dévouement. Comme sa mère n'a plus beaucoup de temps, Lily doit choisir à qui faire confiance avant que le pouvoir de l'homme diabolique ou le secret de l'homme angélique ne la détruisent.

title: Francesca Next Door
description: Woo-ju, a model student and class president who has devoted everything to getting into medical school, finds his life turned upside down when Pi Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. After accidentally becoming the keeper of her secret, Woo-ju finds himself looking after both her studies and school life. As the two constantly bicker and clash, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom between them, leaving Na-young increasingly confused as she struggles to tell whether her racing heart for Woo-ju is the feeling of falling in love or simply her vampire instincts.

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: Spartacus: House of Ashur - Soundtrack | Ashur Ascends | John Hannah & Lucy Lawless | Starz 9p
description:
Step into the blood-stained sands of Capua with Ashur Ascends, an original track inspired by the upcoming Spartacus: House of Ashur. This atmospheric piece blends ancient percussion, war-drums, and haunting Eastern melodies to capture the ruthless rise of Ashur — the most cunning schemer in the gladiator world.

Before Spartacus ever set foot in the arena, Ashur was already weaving lies, alliances, and betrayals inside the House of Batiatus. This track is crafted to reflect his transformation from a struggling gladiator to a master manipulator navigating Roman politics, violence, and survival.

Spartacus: House of Ashur is expected to release in late 2025 / early 2026 and will stream exclusively on Starz.
If you're a fan of the original Spartacus series, gladiator lore, intense character arcs, and cinematic soundscapes, this one’s for you.

Welcome to Popcorn & Tracks — where stories meet sound.

title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.

title: Not Your Family Man
description: Micro Drama

title: The Haunted Honeymoon
description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

title: King in Disguise
description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

title: Final Breakup
description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

title: Payback for Parivaar
description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

title: Adha Pyar
description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

title: Delivery King
description: A humble delivery man is mocked by everyone, but behind his ordinary appearance lies a business genius with unimaginable wealth and influence. As he repeatedly saves a powerful CEO from financial ruin, shocking secrets about his true identity leave his enemies stunned and his allies questioning everything.

title: Ikka Number Paanch
description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino. There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

title: Khamosh Dil
description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

title: He comes from the mountains  [Hindi]
description: .He comes from the mountains

title: Million Dollar Mother [Hindi]
description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.

title: Raja Sahab Returns
description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

title: Unworthy Love
description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

title: Autowala Billionaire
description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

title: Jamai on EMI [Hindi]
description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

title: Bulletproof Ishq
description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!

title: Arranged to Love
description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

title: Lady Boss Returns
description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

title: We, the Emperor
description: Watch "We, the Emperor" Only On KUKKU TV!

title: God Of Cricket
description: A Janitor is a hidden fireball bowler who saves a cricket team from losing the Delhi premiere league.

title: The Undercover Lady CEO
description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

title: Ready Daddy Go!
description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

title: Ek Anjana Rishta
description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

title: Betrayed Heiress
description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

title: College Romance Aur Dhoka
description: College Romance

title: One Last Chance [Hindi]
description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

title: Lost In Love [Hindi]
description: Jab pyaar sirf ek emotion nahi, balki ek dangerous game ban jaata hai, tab har rishta ek nayi twist leta hai. Elle, Ethan aur Jannette ke beech ka yeh triangle sirf love story nahi, ek intense emotional rollercoaster hai jahan trust, betrayal aur revenge sab kuch hai. To ready ho jao ek gripping kahani ke liye jo har episode ke saath aur complicated hoti jaati hai. Abhi dekhna shuru kijiye.

title: Joker Ka Wild Card
description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

title: Dulhan Se Darling
description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

title: Secret Prince
description: So, our hero, born into a super-rich family, is about to be named the next heir to their business empire. But according to their family tradition, the person taking the position has to learn the ropes for 3 months by working at another business, hiding their real identity. That's exactly what our hero does.. He hides who he is and starts working at a business family's place. That's where he meets our heroine, who's already engaged to someone else. Love starts blooming in his heart, too. Now, what's our hero going to do? Is he going to stick to the family tradition? Or is he going to give up the family's custom to marry his girlfriend

title: The Magical Husband
description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Vaishali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

title: Billionaire Became Beggar
description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

title: The Great Indian Cook
description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
description: After five years in hiding, a legendary racer disguised as a mechanic must return to the track to save his village, igniting a high-octane rivalry with the current world champion. Watch now!

title: Billionaire Heist
description: A billionaire with unlimited funds but no proof, Dharam Khurana is trapped in a system that refuses to believe him. As hours tick down and humiliation piles up, one decision changes everything. What begins as a simple plea turns into a dangerous game of power, ego, and survival.

title: Dad With A Dark Side
description: Aravind Varma is an ordinary cleaner. Anu, the CEO of Aditya Group of Hotels, develops feelings for him. Even though he has a son who is of marriageable age, will Aravind marry Anu? The story revolves around the hidden secret in the life of an ordinary cleaner.

title: Shattered Bonds [Kannada]
description: When railway ticket checker (TT/ TC) Ishwar Pratap retires after 40 years of honest service, his three biological children reveal their cruel indifference, forcing him and his devoted wife Rajni into a humiliating separation - until his adopted son Prem and a book of love poems expose the truth about family, sacrifice, and the price of unconditional love.

title: The Sweeper Billionaire
description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

title: The Street Beggar to Billionaire
description: The Street Beggar to Billionaire

title: Dhurandhar Shooter
description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

Play as any soccer or european football team from the Premier League or LALIGA EA SPORTS including Real Madrid & Liverpool in Club Challenge PVP mode. Collect Player Items to build your dream Football Ultimate Team™ with soccer stars Jude Bellingham, Son Heung-Min, Virgil van Dijk, Cole Palmer, Jamal Musiala or legendary ICONs like Ronaldinho, David Beckham, Zinedine Zidane & Zlatan Ibrahimović. FC Mobile has the biggest soccer competitions, leagues, & players across the world with 19,000+ players, from 690 teams, across 35 leagues including the UEFA Champions League.

KEY FEATURES
Score goals with the world’s best players as you level up a team of soccer / european football super stars
Join a League & team up to compete in tournaments and collect more rewards
Compete to Rank Up in PvP soccer game modes including Club Challenge, 1v1 H2H, VS Attack & Football Manager Mode
Earn rewards faster with Daily Training, Quests and Achievements
Play as your favourite UCL team & compete to win the European Cup in the official UEFA Champions League Tournament Mode later in the 25/26 season
Watch FCM TV to see game guides, FCM LIVE streams & soccer match content from the world’s biggest leagues including the Premier League, LALIGA & MLS

COMPETE IN HEAD TO HEAD PVP
Play PVP matches to rank up in Division Rivals
Earn rewards as you climb weekly Leaderboards
Improved ranking system & enhanced matchmaking

JOIN LEAGUES, EARN REWARDS
Bigger Leagues! Join leagues with up to 100 members
Find friends faster with Leagues tagged by language, clubs, region & more
Team up with your league to play tournaments & earn seasonal rewards

AUTHENTIC GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
New Formations: Test out new tactical setups in PvP and PvE matches
Enhanced Passing System: Move the ball with improved precision & control assistance
Player Authenticity: More impactful attributes & skill moves based on their real world performance
Fan Focused Fixes: Improved referee foul detection, reduced effectiveness of kick off rush

CLUB CHALLENGES
Compete as any authentic Premier League or LALIGA EA SPORTS Club in a real time multiplayer PVP game
Play as Real Madrid, Liverpool, Chelsea, Manchester City or FC Bayern Munich & many more

SOCCER LEAGUES, LEGENDS & COMPETITIONS
Premier League, LALIGA EA SPORTS, UEFA Champions League UCL, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 McDonald’s, Serie A Enilive & many more are playable throughout the season
Relive ICONic moments with soccer’s greatest players: Zlatan Ibrahimović, Ronaldinho, Zinedine Zidane, David Beckham, Toni Kroos, Marcelo, Ronaldo, Paolo Maldini & many more

The Club is Yours, Anywhere. Play the world’s game & get the greatest soccer stars & ICONs with EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s 26 Update.

After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

title: A Sense of a Maze
description: In this allegorical documentary we exercise a search for answers to life's unpronounced questions in the labyrinth of a medieval medina. The milestones of the quest are existential, scientific, religious and artistic expressions. Here colors, sounds, figures and authentic musical threads lead the wanderer. The verbal, as well as the visual and sonic guidance concerns eternal truth-seeking, fear, foreignness, the sacredness of life, the discovery of "otherness", the loss of the garden of Eden, inside and outside, work and worship, ecstasy and pacification.

title: A Million a Minute
description: Philip and Miles Quaintance quarrel over the love of Ellen Sheridan; Miles is rejected, while Philip is successful. Philip dies soon after his son is born, and Miles proposes to the widow. When she refuses him, he uses every means to make her unhappy. She leaves the Southland where they live, taking her infant son Stephen. When Stephen has grown to manhood, his mother dies, first telling him the story of Miles' persecution. He is so embittered against his uncle that he avoids meeting him, and he leaves for South Africa. Miles Quaintance amasses a fortune, and in his declining years he hopes to meet Stephen to make restitution for the wrongs he had done his parents. Miles has a ward, Dagmar Lorraine, whom he sends to Paris to study singing. There she meets Etienne, the Duke de Reves, who has an unsavory reputation. He makes violent love to Dagmar and obtains her consent to marry him. After the ceremony a woman enters the church carrying a baby whom she claims is the Duke's son. Horrified, Dagmar flees from the church and returns to America. In a whimsical mood, and partly to atone for the wrongs he had done in his past, Miles makes a will leaving his $10 million fortune to Dagmar and Stephen, provided that they marry and that the wedding takes place before midnight of the following May 31. Miles does not know of Dagmar's wedding and dies before she arrives in America. Stephen is notified of the contents of the strange will at a trading station in Africa. He decides he will take no assistance from his uncle, and with Timothy O'Farrell, a companion, he plans a way out of it. They find the body of a white man floating in the river, and Stephen puts all his papers and trinkets in the pockets of the dead man. Mark Seager, a gunrunner, finds the body and conceives the idea of impersonating the dead man, marrying Dagmar, and claiming the legacy. He sets off for America immediately. Stephen and O'Farrell also leave for America. They are in a restaurant, where they see a man abusing a young girl and using threatening language. It is the valet of the Duke, who has met Dagmar and is trying to blackmail her for his silence. Stephen drives the valet out of the place, and is charmed by the appearance and manner of the girl. She leaves before he can question her. While driving her automobile home that night, Dagmar has trouble with the engine. title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. In the meantime police investigators are arresting catholic clergy for supplying the saboteurs with weapons and false documents. Soldiers are operating in the area of Small Fatra, and it seems there must be someone amongst them who provides the Bandera's with information about planned movements of the army.

title: From C to C: Chinese Canadian Stories of Migration
description: Beautifully filmed in Canada and China's Guangdong province, From C to C is a moving, cinematic tapestry of Chinese Canadian stories of migration. Contrasting the historical injustices faced by Chinese migrants to Canada and their families over the last century, are the experiences of contemporary Chinese Canadian youth who embody diverse, transnational identities across Canada today.

title: Capital C
description: CAPITAL C is the first documentary about crowdfunding. It follows the hopes and dreams as well as the fears and pitfalls of a whole new generation of independent creators, who reach out to the crowd in order to change their lives forever.

title: C.I.C.: Central de Inteligência Cearense
description: A secret agent from the Ceará Intelligence Center is Brazil's last hope to recover stolen data about a top-secret project, that threatens to destroy the country's beaches.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: C Students
description: C students is a 20 minute episode of a YouTube series made by AnimatedJames. It follows the adventures of a Dull and Sarcastic pessimist named August, a Girl crazy pervert named Kevin, and a smart girl named Penny, who never fits in with other girls. The Trio get into misadventures and shenanigans at their school.

title: C.E.O.
description: Ling Min becomes the manager of Haier Factory when the factory is almost bankrupted. He has had no formal education, but on his own, he systematically studies Western theories of industrial management and such classical Chinese philosophies as Confucianism, Taoism, and Suntzu. His first challenge is from the Chinese workers, technicians, and officers, who have been trained to work under the old system and unable to function sufficiently in the new era of international competition. Once his products become good enough, he has to face severe competition, and, in some cases, humiliations, from well-established foreign companies. He and his company succeed in becoming the first Chinese private company to enter the international market, because of hard work, scientific management, and the combination of Western and Eastern philosophy.

title: Lighting up the Stars
description: Having been released after serving his sentence, a funeral director accidentally crosses paths with a girl which brings about an unexpected change in his attitude towards life.

title: Studio C+
description: Join Lisa Clark Valentine as she interviews your favorite cast members, gives a peek behind the scenes, and looks back on fan favorite Studio C moments. Fans interact with the cast through activities like breaking out of an escape room.

title: Road to Success
description: The drama is adapted from the same-titled youth and passionate sports competition novel by author Chang E from Jinjiang Literature City. Doctoral student Lin Wansheng suddenly returns to his hometown and takes up a job as a sports equipment keeper at Hongjing No. 8 Middle School. Wang Fa gives up his job as a coach at a British football club and returns to Hongjing, becoming Lin Wansheng's mysterious tenant. Lin Wansheng is asked to lead the disbanded football team to participate in the league. As expected, they are beaten to a pulp. Thanks to Wang Fa's guidance, they manage to win the game with great difficulty. After that, Lin Wansheng persuades Wang Fa to become the coach, gathers the team members and resolves the internal conflicts. When everything seems to be on the right track, the old wounds of Wang Fa and Lin Wansheng are successively exposed. Both of them choose to escape, but eventually they understand each other. The final of the children's football match and the college entrance examination are approaching. The two join hands to help the children regain their love for football, strive for the college entrance examination and embark on the road to pursue their dreams.

title: Oops! The Alpha's Bride Is a Boy
description: After an unforgettable night with a mysterious man, Fenrir never expects to see him again—until he discovers the stranger is Lucien, the powerful Alpha of the Lusen Family. When Fenrir's twin sister Chloe elopes, he is forced to take her place in a one-month trial marriage with Lucien. Now he must keep his true identity hidden as their forbidden bond grows and the power buried within him begins to awaken.

title: C-38: The Search for Marriage
description: On June 22nd, 2005, Bill C-38 passed a final reading in the House of Commons, making Canada the fourth country in history to officially sanction same-sex marriages. Some saw it as the final hurdle in a 40-year marathon for equality. To others, it undermined an age-old building block of society. This controversial legislation continues to divide the country, and indeed the world, in half. Through interviews with the public as well as experts in various fields, 'C-38: The Search for Marriage' challenges common notions about marriage, sexuality and equality to answer these and other fundamental questions from an equal and fair perspective.

title: Blues Run the Game: The Strange Tale of Jackson C. Frank
description: In the mid-60s, Jackson C. Frank released a masterpiece of folk music in Britain. This young American songwriter was close to Simon & Garfunkel, Bert Jansch, John Renbourn, Al Stewart, Roy Harper, Sandy Denny and many others. All of them were influenced by this enigmatic and tormented character. Shortly after the release of his unique album, he disappeared. Wrecked by a series of tragedies in his life, he chose to cut himself off from the world and got trapped by his demons. Still today, young musicians like John Mayer, Laura Marling or Robin Pecknold perform Blues Run the Game. This documentary follows Jackson C. Frank's footsteps to unknot the threads of a tragic destiny. Facts and songs don't express everything about a man, a personality. Who was Jackson C. Frank? Who remembers him? Where to find meaning, or even light, in a life as dark as his?

title: Murder of Innocence

title: No Sword Can Rival Hers
description: At five, she slew a dragon—then hid her sword for thirteen years. Old law: women who wield swords are crippled or killed. Her aunt won a duel disguised as a man; she was broken and jailed for thirteen years. Now her family falls. Vera disguises as Gavin, sweeps the royal trials, and when orcs storm the capital, she kills the Orc King. The old law dies. Girls can wield swords openly—and Vera frees her aunt.

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Hear Me, Mommy? Now Let's Get Rich!
description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. Ann soon learns that the powerful Lowe family and her father, Cory Lowe, plan to cast Eva aside because she is carrying a daughter. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: Love, Lost and Found（DUBBED）
description: Mia Sanders, a kind-hearted young woman, has been labeled as a jinx by her family from the day she was born. Not only does her father treat her as if she's invisible, but even the household servants look down on her. In stark contrast, her twin sister, Molly Sanders, is the favored one. Molly subjects Mia to ceaseless mistreatment and oppression, and Mia can only endure it. She holds onto the belief that she can escape this life once she grows up and moves out.

title: Swallowed Star S1-S2
description: This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.

title: Baby Chef Is Not Someone To Mess With
description: A six-year-old culinary prodigy, Katherine, fights to save her critically ill mother, Master Renee. Her remarkable talent draws the attention of Heinz Group CEO Leon, sparking a showdown with ruthless rivals, ultimately culminating in their family's reunion and the Golden Fork crown.

title: IS-22
description: After the world is taken over by a virus, Chase Aimers (a survivalist) is trying to lead a group to a Infection Station known as IS-22. They will find out that having each other is their best way of survival.

description: A hacker sacrifices himself fighting an AI, reincarnates as a sect leader in a cultivation world. He must stay discreet while managing duties and threats, aided by system agent Jiang Que.

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Mais Loïc, qui en a assez de ramper, décide d'exploiter un bug du système pour empocher d'énormes sommes d'argent, et pour s'acheter tout ce qu'il désire. Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Stellar Transformation S1-S6
description: In order to gain the respect of his father, a kid without innate ability to practice internal techniques, resolutely chooses to follow the more difficult path of practicing external techniques. Will he be able to gain his father's respect?

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

title: Midnight Breaks
description: When sweet-voiced Cassie (Dawn Hope) of unsigned reggae act Midnight is offered a lucrative deal to join successful group Breaks by record company rep Billy (Toyah Willcox), her bandmate boyfriend Tyron (Letts) is less than thrilled.

title: Sleep With My Husband's Brother
description: After her parents were murdered, she married into the enemy's family under a false name to protect her unconscious brother and find out the truth. An unexpected misflirtation accidentally provoked the vicious second master who fell in love with her at first sight.

title: A Love Paid in Tears
description: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

title: Rooftops
description: A touring musician returns home to spend time with old friends and an old flame for a day. Just as times begin to feel right again, she has to reckon with leaving again.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: Love Unexpected
description: A sweet love story between an emotionally detached CEO and a female bodyguard who is full of empathy.

title: A Twist of Fate
description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. As adults, a twist of fate brought them together, but Laurel, fearing rejection, chose to hide her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else impersonated her, leading to a series of misunderstandings. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

title: My Annoying Roommate
description: In the second semester of her junior year, 17-year-old Su Qiao welcomed her new desk mate, the "big celebrity" Lin Zilu. However, his appearance immediately brought misfortune to Su Qiao.

title: One Punch Man vs. Mosquito
description: Is One-Punch Man unbeatable or did a mosquito expose him? The unending battle between man and bug rages on.

title: A Summertime Drug
description: Stand up Comedian Louis C vents about his childhood, adulthood and relentless failures with relationships. A Summertime Drug was filmed during back to back nights for 2 sold out crowds at The Stage Door in Elko, NV.

title: Veil of Vengeance: The Woman in Disguise
description: After her marriage to Shawn Holt is destroyed by Sherry Lind, Penny Lind loses the family she tried so hard to protect. Seeking revenge, she transforms into Xandra Ford and returns to make Sherry pay for her actions. However, Zack Green mistakenly believes Xandra is responsible for Penny’s disappearance and stands in her way.

title: RICH GIRL REBORN:GOING CRAZY FOR LOVE
description: Choi Cheong-yeon and Kim Myeong-nam are lovers whose relationship is tested time and again. A crisis at her family’s company and a web of complicated relationships leave Cheong-yeon struggling. Though Myeong-nam remains devoted to her, misunderstandings and sinister schemes drive them apart. Caught in the plots of Park Yong-jun and Choi Hyo-jin, the couple endure countless hardships, with Myeong-nam even suffering a life-threatening injury. Yet their love and trust help them expose the conspiracies and overcome every obstacle. Myeong-nam thwarts Yong-jun’s plans and saves the Choi Group, while Cheong-yeon clears her family’s name. Finally united, they prove that true love can conquer even the greatest challenges.

title: The Hunt of the Son of Beast
description: Andrew, David and his friends are taking a vacation to Kings Island when something strange and mysterious is happening and it's returning.

title: Perfect and Casual [Hindi]
description: It tells the romantic story between Zhang Sinian, the aloof and monastic "Mr. Perfect" and Yun Shu, the laid-back and cheerful "Miss Almost".

title: Kirby and the Disaster Transport
description: Kirby and his dream friends investigate some strange happenings in Alaska.

title: From Rejected to the Alpha Queen
description: The only daughter of the Alpha King, Isabella, lost everything during a massacre and even became a slave to another pack. Years later, her childhood knight suddenly reappears and guides her in regaining her white wolf powers. They then fight side by side to bring down the all the liars, traitors, and murderers in their lives.

title: Blades of the Guardians [English]
description: Dao Ma walks in the desert of the Western regions. On the way, he took a guarding task with a destination to Chang'an. The task seemed simple at first, but it is a road full of danger. A journey affecting the fate of the world begins..

title: One fateful Night with My Neighbor Boss（DUBBED）
description: After a one-night stand with Kim Tae-on, Yoon Ha-jung gives birth to twins. However, her ruthless stepsister, Yoon Se-ra, secretly steals one of the babies and claims the child as her own. She becomes Kim Tae-on's fiancee through deception. Six years later, Yoon Ha-jung returns under a new identity—the famous perfumer, Arta.

title: Secret Baby, Billionaire Daddy(Dubbed)
description: To investigate his mother's death, Mason becomes a taxi driver and has a one-night stand with beautiful CEO Victoria. Years later, she returns with their daughter and proposes to him. When she's humiliated at a banquet, Mason's billionaire father steps in, revealing his real identity.

title: The Eight-Year-Old Patriarch Return of the Supreme Mage
description: Supreme Mage Merlin wakes after a century, turns the Hell King into a goat mount, and returns home. His family is being destroyed by the Malphas family. He lifts his sister’s curse, defeats the three-headed hellhound, and begins his counterattack.

title: Legend of Yun Xi
description: A young naive girl skilled in magical medicine and poisons meets cruel power struggle, villains, friends and love.

title: Secretary Ye's Attached Boss
description: A girl, solely chosen as the personal secretary because of her resemblance to the CEO's first love, spent five years by his side. She believed her own love story had finally arrived, only to discover that he was about to get engaged...

title: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage
description: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage

title: Werewolf King's Hidden Heir
description: Human girl Nellie, drunk, stumbles into werewolf king Clifford's territory, has a one-night stand with him, and flees. Five years later, she applies to be his family doctor for her sick son Brady—only to discover her employer is the man from that night. Recognizing her, Clifford relentlessly pursues her while Brady's werewolf blood awakens. Werewolf nobles repeatedly frame Brady as a "cursed child" and try to kill him, but Clifford protects his family. At their wedding, he exposes the conspiracy and proves Brady's pure lineage. Nellie accepts his proposal, Brady gains the pack's acceptance, and the three live happily ever after.

title: The Land of Warriors
description: After the finals, Tang San parts ways with friends for five years of training. He reunites them to form the Tang Sect and confront Bibi Dong's sinister ambitions, protecting the Douluo Continent.
